name: Battlezone Auxiliary Math Box PCB
drawing: DP-156 sheet 3 Side B, section of 035678-01
coverage: 36 devices from DP-156 sheet 3 Side B -- the whole sheet: Math Box, Output Latch, Audio Output, Control Panel Inputs and Audio Generator, Power Input, cross-checked against the Figure 1 test-point map on sheet 1 Side B. This is the Auxiliary PCB 035678-01, a different board from the Battlezone game PCB, and the board Red Baron shares. Grid positions are read off the drawing; the board outline and pitch are the standard Atari grid, not a measured dimension. A board map for diagnosis, not a complete bill of materials.
